title: School Science, Vol. IV No. 4, December 1965: Workshop of Science Club Sponsors
publisher: National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT), Department of Science Education
event_scope: Interstate science-club sponsors' teacher workshop held in Madras; not a Kerala science fair
archival_provenance: Internet Archive item identifies Digital Library of India, C-DAC Noida scanning centre and NCERT source library. The bound-volume scan contains the original December 1965 issue cover and contents; accession/upload dates are not publication dates.

locators.supports: December 1965 issue cover, Vol. IV No. 4
Issue contents assign News and Notes to printed page 329
Workshop dates, Madras venue, three participating states, 21 combined teachers, practical training and more than 100 project outlines intended for later school trials
locators.page_number_note: The first News and Notes page has no visible page numeral; contents and the following printed 330 establish printed 329.

review_scope: Visually checked issue covers, contents, workshop page and following page; OCR/XML were used to locate passages. This is not a claim of exhaustive visual review of all 369 pages.
notes: Reports participation from Mysore, Kerala and Madras at Madras Christian College High School, 19–28 December 1965. The 21 teachers are a three-state total; no Kerala subtotal or names are supplied. Project trials are prospective. The issue month is not an exact release date. This neither locates a fair in Kerala nor establishes a statewide inauguration.

locators.supports: Source-wording anomaly: science-club initiation printed as 1967–68 in a March 1967 issue
National science-fair programme account and district/state/regional totals for 1962–63 to 1965–66

source_wording_note: Dashes in the table are retained, not converted to zeros. Printed 36/PDF 46 says science-club activities were initiated in 1967–68, despite the March 1967 issue date; that clause is preserved as an anomaly, not corrected or used as a founding-date fact.
review_scope: Visually checked issue contents, article attribution/conference footnote, printed 36 and printed 37. OCR/XML aided discovery; the full bound volume has not received exhaustive visual review.
notes: A contemporary survey published by NCERT, rather than original 1960 council minutes or a Kerala government administration order. Five state fairs are listed for 1965–66 but the states are unnamed. Neither that total nor the nearby national Central Science Club count establishes a Kerala statewide fair inaugural year or proves that Kerala's contemplated club opened.
